when_to_use_open_questions: resolver un caso donde la formulación sea parte del aprendizaje
explicar un razonamiento que no pueda evaluarse razonablemente con opciones

choice_interaction.selection_method: tap option directly; no separate dropdown
choice_interaction.after_check: lock the answer permanently and persist result locally and in cloud

rules: randomize the order of plausible alternatives
keep A/B/C/D approximately balanced across a practice
update the stored correct answer whenever alternatives are reordered

practice_design.supervision_language: Do not present A/B/C as a learner-facing taxonomy. Explain explicitly whether AI can execute alone, requires human review, or requires a human final decision.
